This Fort was built by the Portuguese in 1640 CE, as a strategic watchtower, to guard their settlement and defend the Mumbai Harbour from invaders. Located near Land's End, this ancient structure offers not just history lessons but an opportunity to decode but an opportunity to decode a rich maritime legacy. Conquering the sea, a view at a time Where else can you truly enjoy a view of the open sea if not from the top. Perched at a height of 24 m (79 ft), this vantage point has a walkway lined with palm trees and benches to the Arabian Sea. Owing to its towering structure, the Bandra Fort makes for the perfect spot to soak in stunning panoramic seascapes and sunset views. Architectural grandeur nestled amidst nature Be amazed to encounter beautiful landscape gardens at every level of climbing the Bandra Fort. Marvel at its European-style architecture pieced together with granite blocks and arched pillars. The inside of the fort has sections for different purposes, such as storage, barracks, chapel, and watchtower. The fort also has gaps for cannons and guns that were used to fire at enemy ships. Discover a serene haven within its wall. Aptly named Staircase Park, this magnificent space offers a perfect setting for both leisure and recreation. From meditation and exercise sessions to simply taking leisurely strolls through its gates, this tranquil location has been everyone’s favourite getaway since time immemorial. Where art inspires art Owing to its picturesque location and unique architectural beauty, the Bandra Fort has long been revered by artists and filmmakers alike. Many Bollywood movies were filmed here like "Dil Chahta Hai," "Wanted," "Jane Tu Ya Jane Na" and "Buddha Mil Gaya." Most of them went on to become huge successes at the box-office. Begin your journey from a visit to the Basilica of Our Lady of the Mount (commonly referred to as Mount Mary Church). Resting upon a picturesque hillock overlooking the Arabian Sea, this divine sanctum stands as an icon of unwavering faith. Beyond its architectural marvels, its miraculous and mystical history draws hundreds of thousands of devotees worldwide. Next stop - Mumbai's crowning glory, the Juhu Beach. Take a stroll on the golden sands along its coastline while listening to the soothing rhythms of the Arabian Sea. As the city's most beloved beach, it is filled with visitors throughout the day. Indulge yourself in its atmosphere, sample delicious street food, or perhaps catch a glimpse of Bollywood celebrities passing by. For an immersive and truly tranquil experience, visit early in the morning when the sun rises over the captivating shoreline. A trip to Mumbai won’t be complete without exploring Mumbai's famed Film City. Witness the glorious industry that Bollywood is at this vast 520-acre complex that is always filled with energy and enthusiasm. Boasting of over 20 studios, Film City provides an immersive cinematic experience like no other. Gear yourself up for an entertaining tour. Watch live shoots in action or even better join an exciting film-making workshop to bring out the entertainer in you. Last, but not the least, feed your gastronomical cravings. Mumbai's vibrant culinary offerings span from humble street food to exquisite dining experience. Don’t miss out on Mumbai's signature dishes, like Vada Pav, Pav Bhaji, Bhel Puri and Sev Puri. They are sure to delight your tastebuds while providing an irresistibly tantalising sensory experience. Continue your culinary journey by sampling some delectable Parsi cuisine. The harmonious mix of Iranian and Indian spices is sure to leave a lasting impression on you.
